method: Built-in image_gen, one call per object with transparent_background=true. Selected original PNGs copied unchanged. WebP derivatives proportionally fit within 512x512 via Pillow RGBA/LANCZOS; quality 88, alpha_quality 95, method 6. No raw provider or paid story/voice generation.
